name: Owkin
description: Owkin build AI agents for biology to accelerate drug discovery and de-risk clinical trials. The Owkin connector currently powers HistoPLUS, an agent that transforms H&E slides from the TCGA database into granular, queryable insights. Researchers can use it to quantify distinct cell types, analyze complex spatial tumor microenvironments, and validate hypotheses through cohort-level survival analysis. Use this connector to bridge the gap between raw biological data and actionable patient stratification, starting with histopathology.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Owkin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Owkin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.k.owkin.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Owkin MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Owkin provides these MCP tools: list_cell_types, list_cohorts, features_description, filter_slides, get_histomics, display_slide_thumbnail, survival_analysis, histoplus_help, and download_histomics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Owkin?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Owkin in life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include AdisInsight, Boltz API, Helix GenoSphere, Inductive Bio, and LatchBio.
Owkin requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Owkin is developed by Owkin. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
